subject: INVOKE statement
notes: cite.py --check 14.9.23.3 'Identifier-1 shall be an object reference' OK 1). Every identifier format that IS an object reference is a receiver: a data item (a non-object identifier-1 is COBOL0824 naming SR1, negative pb1136-invoke-receiver-not-object-reference), an object-view and an inline invocation (kb/Work PB1425, golden pb1425_computed_object_reference_operands), SELF / [x OF] SUPER, and since w1112b the predefined NULL: INVOKE NULL compiles (OoBinder.OoBindNullInvoke screens the operand-only syntax rules SR9-SR17 with no method to read) and raises EC-OO-NULL by 14.9.23.4 GR5 (golden pb1136_invoke_null_receiver: HANDLED=EC-OO-NULL twice, W and X unchanged). It was the deferral COBOL1756 and a run-time NotImplemented abort. kb/Work PB1136 landed.
